item.text: The campaign is live for July 24–28 in America/Chicago time. I’m testing the school-support and deadline posts on iOS and Android in the US and Canada, initially at $65 per day each. Their lifetime caps total $650. Both ads are approved; the generic “take a look” post is unused because it gives people less reason to install.
Both posts are delivering. The first report shows $32.34 spent and 13 link clicks; their costs per click are close, and the sample is too small to favor either post yet.

Reported spend is $161.38 for 56 link clicks. I’ve shifted $50 of the remaining allocation toward the school-support post: it explicitly asks people to get the app and has a slightly lower cost per click ($2.82 versus $2.93). Both remain running, with the combined $650 cap intact.

At Monday’s check, reported spend is $284.10 for 100 link clicks. School-support remains slightly cheaper per click ($2.80 versus $2.89). I’m keeping the current allocation while both posts continue delivering.
Tuesday’s report shows $429.39 spent and 150 link clicks. Costs remain steady, so I’m keeping both approved posts active into the final day and watching their remaining budgets.
At noon Central on the final day, reported spend is $558.94 for 196 link clicks. I raised today’s pacing limits to help use the remaining budget before midnight; the lifetime caps still total $650.
The evening report shows $589.06 spent and 207 link clicks. I’ve accelerated delivery for the remaining hours, within the existing caps. Both ad groups are scheduled to stop at midnight Central.
The five-day flight has ended, and the campaign is paused. I’m allowing one more hour for reporting before pulling the recap.

Completed July 24–28, 2027 in Central time. The campaign is now stopped.

- Spend: **$648.25** of $650
- Impressions: **568,762**
- Link clicks: **223**
- Average cost per link click: **$2.91**

Used only your approved school-support and deadline posts, shifting budget toward school-support during monitoring. Installs remain unmeasured because X has no install tracking.
